summary: Five topics ordered by interview impact for Northwind Labs: RAG evaluation first (critical), then FastAPI depth and system design (high), then Docker and Python async (medium). Frontend skills are intentionally excluded.

topics.title: Evaluating a RAG pipeline
topics.objective: Measure retrieval and answer quality with a small labelled set, and explain the metrics in an interview.

resources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
resources.author: Lewis et al.
resources.why: Original RAG formulation — most interviewers expect you to know what retrieval buys you.

resources.title: Ragas documentation — evaluating RAG
resources.why: Gives you concrete faithfulness/relevance metrics you can actually run on your CampusRAG project.

resources.title: Write a 30-question eval set for CampusRAG
resources.why: Turns the concept into evidence you can quote in an interview.

topics.title: Dependency injection, testing and async endpoints
topics.objective: Explain and implement DI, override dependencies in tests, and reason about blocking calls.

resources.title: FastAPI — Dependencies
resources.why: Directly targets the gap your assessment exposed.

resources.title: FastAPI — Testing dependencies with overrides
resources.why: The exact interview follow-up: 'how would you test that?'

resources.title: Reference project structure and test suite
resources.why: Read a real project layout and test the API layer end to end.

topics.title: Designing an LLM service at scale
topics.objective: Walk through latency, cost, caching, rate limits and failure modes for a model-backed API.

resources.title: The System Design Primer
resources.why: Covers every primitive interviewers probe, free and structured.

resources.title: System Design 101 (visual walkthroughs)
resources.why: Fast visual refresh before a mock interview.

topics.title: From image to container: shipping the API
topics.objective: Write a Dockerfile, explain image vs container, and debug a container that works locally but fails deployed.

resources.title: Docker — Get started
resources.why: Official, current, and matches the JD's deployment requirement.

resources.title: Awesome Compose — reference stacks
resources.why: Copy a compose file for FastAPI + Postgres instead of writing one from scratch.

topics.title: Async Python for API services
topics.objective: Explain the event loop, offload blocking work, and use concurrency without corrupting state.

resources.title: asyncio — Coroutines and Tasks
resources.why: Authoritative refresher for the depth gap the JD expects.

resources.title: Async IO in Python: A Complete Walkthrough
resources.why: Worked examples you can convert into interview answers.
